senses.gloss: [something with which to peel or scrape,] fragment of a vessel, potsherd.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 26:23">Targ. Prov. XXVI, 23</cite>.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 18a:13">Kidd. 18ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>נקיט … יהיבנא ליה ח׳</he> he had a pearl in his hand, and we give him a sherd, i.e. for a valuable object we give him a valueless paper; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חַסְפִּין</he>, <cite ref="H01406"><he>חִ׳</he></cite>.
